bullets.text: In Chennai, a man died and his colleague is critical after falling into a septic tank in Pallikaranai.
In Ambattur, a man was stabbed to death by his younger brother following a dispute over harassment of his daughter.
The Tamil Nadu State Wetlands Authority reduced the interim buffer zone of the Pallikaranai Ramsar wetland significantly.
The Velachery Resident Welfare Association hosted a thanksgiving lunch to honour sanitation workers for maintaining neighbourhood hygiene.
The Tamil Nadu State Wetlands Authority proposed allowing certain construction projects around the Pallikaranai wetland.
Activists criticized the Greater Chennai Corporation for leaving the Marina beach pathway tender for persons with disabilities incomplete.
In Thiruvallur, citizens waiting to submit petitions faced official apathy as officials were engrossed in their cell phones.
Residents in Thiruvallur protested against proposed municipal projects including a sewage treatment plant at the Tiruverkadu burial ground.
Police arrested individuals in Avadi who cheated people of six crore rupees through a fake online trading training scam.
IBM partnered with MeitY and Bharat Core to boost India deep-tech startups, with the MD outlining a vision for Digital Swaraj.
Adani Enterprises and Jabil signed a pact to form a fifty-fifty joint venture in India for AI and data centre hardware manufacturing.
Zoho skipped its annual salary hikes for 2026 as co-founder Sridhar Vembu cited surging AI infrastructure costs and an uncertain outlook.
Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan is scheduled to visit Chennai on Thursday to engage with Tamil Nadu as a key economic partner.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay will lay the foundation stone for a major ring main pipeline project in Sholinganallur.
